scope: Matched ordinary warm/primed-PLE prefill W1-W5: ExLlamaV3 master 058b8630 (version string 1.6.2) versus exllamav3-fuzev v1.1 on the upstream 1.6.1 base 3a513ac9.

candidate.code: The candidate patch is unpublished. Its hyperconnections.py and optimized/profile.json changes are in exllamav3-fuzev v1.1; decision measurements precede the decision-root scheduling fix.

formulae.native_time_ratio: arithmetic mean upstream time_prefill_s / arithmetic mean final time_prefill_s
formulae.wall_time_ratio: arithmetic mean upstream wall_s / arithmetic mean final wall_s
formulae.mean_per_row_tokens_per_s: arithmetic mean of saved per-row rates; not used to form time ratios

primary_selection.W4: Only variant=Full for primary comparison, two rows. repeat_Full is separate control evidence, not pooled.
primary_selection.other_W4_ablations: Other W4 ablations are in final-loo-w4.json.

w4_current_control_sensitivity.scope: Within-final Full/repeat_Full, same offsets; not an upstream self-repeat.

host_memory_interval.scope: Host-memory samples over the whole comparison session, including other work and idle periods.

limits: W4 final Full rows are reused from an interleaved four-arm LOO panel versus standalone upstream W4.
W2 uses the matched final-fresh offsets.
One load per panel, two distinct offsets. Upstream repeat-control noise, independent-load variance and confidence intervals are unmeasured.
Performance means exclude warmups, loading, PLE priming, prefix setup, feature capture and generation.
Counts describe harness accounting. Physical chunk and forward calls were unobserved.
Torch allocated-memory peaks cover the measured intervals. Prime/setup memory and total host/device residency are outside that measure.
The archive records only summary statistics of the host-memory log.
